{{Quote|Damn it, Krupo! I told you how precious my babies are to me, and you go and crash the ship with them in it!|Yarvok, about his pets|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Ol' Cronchy''' was a [[Zeldrate]] owned by [[Yarvok]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Yarvok was very fond of Ol' Cronchy, calling the pet his "beloved." Yarvok felt similar about his other Zeldrate, [[Spike (pet)|Spike]]. [[Krupo]], Yarvok's beast wrangler, lost Ol' Cronchy along with many of Yarvok's other pets after his ship carrying the pets unexpectedly crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], angering and worrying [[Yarvok]]. Yarvok said he would [[Death/Legends|kill]] Krupo if his missing pets, including Ol' Cronchy, were not returned with haste, as Yarvok believed the pets to be terrified out alone on the "grass ball" of Dantooine alone without him.<ref name="Codex" />

When the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] landed on Dantooine to investigate reports of [[Darth Malgus]] at the [[Jedi Enclave]], Ol' Cronchy could be seen with several of Yarvok's other lost pets, [[Fuzzy (Xuvva)|Fuzzy]] and [[Yug]], around the Enclave's approach. Ol' Cronchy had a preference for the crash-landed shipments of frozen meats scattered near its surroundings.<ref name="Enclave">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Secrets of the Enclave}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ol' Cronchy appeared in the flashpoint Secrets of the Enclave and was mentioned in the Codex entry for Invasive Species on Dantooine in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
